reviews.text: Still irks me how close they put the fence to the hot tub leaving no walking room.  The fence is very good and has prevented any unwanted child or pet access to the pool area.  The workers and the owner thought this looked okay.  Everyone that sees it remarks at how ridiculous it was done, when it could have easily split the difference for walking room on both sides.
reviews.author: Jay Allport

reviews.text: We could not have been happier with Fence Fanatics!! They were so easy to work with, gave us a quick and accurate quote, and made sure the finished product was exactly what we needed. We wanted an easy, removable safety option around our pool to help keep the littles safe. We worked together to come up with the perfect solution that still left the pool accessible and usable without taking up too much of our outside space.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Martin

reviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with Fence Fanatics starting with the consultation with Alex all the way through the crew coming out to complete the job. We were kept informed about permit status, weather conditions, and the final project was absolutely beautiful. Everyone was kind and professional and their bid also beat out the compition. I have already sent a few recomendations out to family and friends but wanted to spread the word about this company as much as I could. Their workmanship and values are hard to find.
reviews.author: James Pearce II

reviews.text: Carl Goodman lives in my neighorhood and he came to give me an estimate when I was looking to replace my old fence.  He's very pleasant to work with.  All paperworks and payment were done electronically which suits me perfectly.  The installation of the fence was done weeks ahead of schedule which was great.  The fence was installed efficiently.  The Fence Fanatics staff were great to work with and went about their installation job timely.  The end result was excellent.  Will highly recomment Fence Fanatics to anyone needing any fence installation.
reviews.author: Jack G

reviews.text: Fence Fanatics did an outstanding job on our repair project. From our initial inquiry to finished product they were quick, professional, affordable. Definitely your go-to contact for any fencing need.
reviews.author: Judy Wesen

reviews.text: In a world where great contractors are now hard to find.. Fence Fanatics is phenomenal. Great communication, great folks who did rhe work, and great end result.  Loved the whole process beginning to finish.  Thank you guys again for the work.  Carl is a great asset to the team and customer satisfaction.
reviews.author: Kevin Buczek

reviews.text:
We used Fence Fanatics to repair the retaining wall on our property. The team was a pleasure to work with! Carl did a fabulous job with our proposal process and was responsive to questions (even over the weekend). He was always in contact with us for updates on timing and next steps. The team was always on time for work and went above and beyond. The property was left tidy and the teams worked very hard. Additionally, the manager came by the property often to check on progress and give us updates.

We did have a 3rd party vendor make a delivery in an undesignated location and when contacted, the FF team was out immediately with several people to fix the problem! They did not cause the problem, but our satisfaction was the most important thing to the group.

Lastly, the team installed a small chicken wire fence to keep the puppy from escaping until she got bigger. The team made a stop at our home ahead of time to install that fence just for our convenience.

I would highly recommend Fence Fanatics. Their service is impeccable. Their communication should be what every company strives for. I love our finished product (quality work) and would recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Maughon

reviews.text: We recently had part of our fence blow over due to wind. We've had this happen before and another fence company didn't do the best job. This time around, Fence Fanatics came out and fixed it! It is much sturdier before. Great communication and VERY prompt. We had someone out within two hours to assess. Carl was also very helpful and kind! Would recommend
reviews.author: Ariana Baxter

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The single detailed negative review on Google adds significant credibility, as it describes a specific planning error and the owner's professional response offers a remedy. Positive reviews are detailed and span several years. The low volume on Yelp, Angi, and Houzz is not a strong fake signal for a local contractor, where Google is the primary review platform.
fake_signals: Very low review volume on secondary platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)
authentic_signals: Specific negative review with detailed complaint
Owner provides professional, solution-oriented response to negative review
Positive reviews mention specific staff (Alex, Carl Goodman) and processes (permits, electronic payment)
Varied writing styles and dates spanning years
complaint_patterns: Poor layout/planning (fence too close to hot tub)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.8), Yelp (4.5), and BBB (A+). Minor platforms (Angi, Houzz) also show perfect scores, but with very few reviews, which is not unusual.
